data.description: Live Smart, Live Grand – Explore Jouri Hills Dubai

data.answer:
Jouri Hills Jumeirah Golf Estates enjoys a prime location near the intersection of Yalais Street, Jebel Ali-Al Hibab Road, and Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street. Its strategic positioning ensures easy access to key road networks, making daily commutes convenient.

For a detailed overview of amenities, attractions, and lifestyle benefits, explore the Jouri Hills neighborhood guide.

Nestled within Jumeirah Golf Estates, the Jouri Hills Dubai location offers an exclusive collection of 294 stylish residences. These include 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses, 5-bedroom villas, two types of 5-bedroom Signature Villas, and the ultra-luxurious 6-bedroom mansion. Designed with a contemporary aesthetic, each home features smart technology, nature-inspired interiors, and premium European appliances, ensuring a refined living experience.

Renting a Property in Jouri Hills

Currently, rental options are not available as Jouri Hills is an off-plan development. However, upon completion, the Jouri Hills community overview suggests that the project will cater to discerning residents seeking a high-end lifestyle within Jumeirah Golf Estates. Homeowners will enjoy spacious layouts, private outdoor areas, and modern smart-home features, making it a prestigious residential destination.

Buying a Property in Jouri Hills

Prospective buyers can explore a flexible payment structure, with the most popular option being the 60/40 plan. This involves a 20% down payment, 40% spread over seven installments, and the remaining 40% due at handover in 2025. 

Additionally, Jouri Hills facilities and amenities elevate the living experience, offering private swimming pools, saunas, home theaters, floor-to-ceiling windows, covered parking, and golf carts for every homeowner. Signature villas and mansions also come with exclusive resort-style luxuries, reinforcing Jouri Hills as a premier residential choice.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Jouri Hills Jumeirah Golf Estates?

data.answer:
For a glimpse into upscale living, explore the Jouri Hills neighborhood guide, which highlights its smart-home residences, lush landscapes, and world-class golf facilities. This exclusive community offers a perfect blend of modern comfort and natural tranquility.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Jouri Hills

Once completed, Jouri Hills will offer seamless connectivity for residents. The Jumeirah Golf Estates Metro Station will provide a convenient public transport option, while private cars and taxis will ensure hassle-free commutes. 

Each home will feature dedicated covered parking spaces, with ample room for multiple vehicles in villas and mansions.

Supermarkets Around Jouri Hills

As part of the Jouri Hills facilities and amenities, residents will have access to well-known supermarkets within the Jumeirah Golf Estates master community. Spinneys, located nearby, will offer a range of grocery essentials along with doorstep delivery services for added convenience.

Fairway The Marketplace by Choithrams, a medium-sized supermarket in the town center, will be another go-to option. As a trusted name in Dubai, Choithrams will provide a wide selection of groceries, fresh produce, and online delivery services, ensuring that future residents have everything they need within easy reach.

Shopping Malls Near Jouri Hills

While the master community, Jumeirah Golf Estates will feature The Clubhouse with select retail options, there will be no dedicated mall within the community. However, residents will have convenient access to shopping malls near Jouri Hills, with City Centre Me’aisem being the closest option.

Located just 15 minutes away in Production City, this Majid Al Futtaim mall will serve as a community-focused lifestyle destination. It will offer a variety of retail stores, dining options, and essential services, including pharmacies and banking facilities, ensuring that residents have access to everyday conveniences.

Nurseries and Schools Near Jouri Hills

Families will have access to quality education within the Jumeirah Golf Estates master community. Schools near Jouri Hills Dubai will include Victory Heights Primary School, located within a 20-minute drive, offering a strong academic foundation. For younger children, Kinder Castle Nursery will be a convenient option, ensuring a nurturing early learning environment.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Jouri Hills

Residents will benefit from well-equipped healthcare centers near Jouri Hills, ensuring easy access to medical services. Aster Clinic Sports City will be the closest healthcare facility, providing comprehensive medical care. 

Additionally, Medicina Pharmacy Victory Heights will cater to daily pharmaceutical needs, while other healthcare facilities will be within a short drive. As part of Jouri Hills facilities and amenities, residents will also have access to high-end wellness options within the Jumeirah Golf Estates Clubhouse.

Location & Nearby Areas

Situated within Jumeirah Golf Estates, the Jouri Hills Dubai location ensures excellent connectivity to key areas of the city. Residents will be able to reach Dubai Marina in just 19 minutes via E44, offering access to waterfront attractions and vibrant nightlife.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road will be just a 5-minute drive away, providing seamless routes to various parts of Dubai. Additionally, Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa will be accessible within 30 minutes, making Jouri Hills a well-connected and strategically located community.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Jouri Hills Dubai

data.answer:
Residents will enjoy a premium lifestyle with Jouri Hills facilities and amenities, including access to world-class golf courses, fitness centers, and lush green spaces. The community will also feature high-end dining options, leisure trails, and exclusive clubhouse experiences for a well-rounded living environment.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

The master plan of Jouri Hills highlights a range of exciting recreational and wellness-focused amenities, ensuring an active and well-balanced lifestyle.

A key feature of Jouri Hills Dubai parks and recreation is the extensive sporting facilities available to all residents at no extra cost. The community will include a neighborhood park with local sports facilities, featuring a football pitch, basketball and tennis courts, and an entertainment zone. Residents will also receive a complimentary membership to the Wellfit gym, promoting a fitness-driven lifestyle.

For outdoor enthusiasts, the community will offer shaded seating areas, an amphitheater, and dedicated cycling and jogging tracks. Additionally, Jouri Hills will feature a skate park and children’s playground, creating a dynamic and family-friendly environment.

Community Events

Future residents of Jouri Hills Dubai can look forward to a vibrant social calendar with exclusive community events held at the Jumeirah Golf Estates Clubhouse. From seasonal celebrations to wellness workshops and sports tournaments, the community will foster an engaging and connected lifestyle for families and individuals alike.

Attractions and Landmarks

The Jouri Hills Dubai location ensures residents have convenient access to some of Dubai’s top attractions. City Centre Me’aisem will be just a 10-minute drive via Al Fay Road, offering retail, dining, and entertainment options. Dubai International Stadium, a premier venue for major sporting events, will be reachable in 14 minutes.

For those who enjoy nature, Dubai Miracle Garden will be a 16-minute drive via Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), showcasing breathtaking floral displays. The Els Club, a world-class golf destination, will be 17 minutes away via Golf Course Drive, while motorsport enthusiasts can reach Dubai Autodrome in the same timeframe via Al Fay Road, making Jouri Hills a well-connected and dynamic residential community.

As an off-plan development, Jouri Hills Jumeirah Golf Estates is currently under construction, with handover expected in Q2 2025. Buyers seeking immediate occupancy may need to consider alternative options, but the long-term benefits of investing in this prestigious community include luxury living, state-of-the-art amenities, and access to world-class golf courses.

data.content:
Jouri Hills Dubai is an exclusive residential community within Jumeirah Golf Estates (JGE), a world-class golf destination. Developed by Arada Developments LLC., this off-plan project features 294 luxury homes, including villas, townhouses, and mansions, designed to offer an elevated lifestyle.

Strategically positioned, the Jouri Hills Dubai location ensures seamless connectivity to key areas in the city. Residents will enjoy access to premium golf courses, lush green spaces, and top-tier amenities, making it a sought-after address for those seeking luxury and tranquility.

Construction began in 2023, with handover expected in Q2 2025. Intermass has been appointed for residential development, while Proscape will oversee landscaping and infrastructure, ensuring a well-crafted and sophisticated community.
